title: Project switcher: old look with status pills, and removing a synced project everywhere — round 2

steps.headline: The switcher is back to its old look — search row, Recent, plain rows, Add a project — keeping the new sync pills.
steps.changed: Round 1's popup shell is gone. Sync pills stay; unsynced folders now say "Not synced". Counts are "21 files · 5 chats" with bold numbers.
steps.notice: The project you're in has a small check beside its name here; two other ways to mark it are the choice further on.

steps.path: Projects → click the name, with many projects (one folder moved away)
steps.headline: Many projects, old look: the list scrolls as before, and a moved-away folder shows an amber "Folder missing" pill.
steps.changed: Same states as round 1 (sync pills, Folder missing, no counts on a missing folder), on the old container.
steps.notice: The search row and Add a project sit where they always did.

steps.path: Project switcher, pointer on the second row
steps.headline: The bin shows only on the row you point at; on other rows the counts and pill sit flush right.
steps.changed: The bin takes no space until you point at a row or move to it with the arrow keys.
steps.notice: On a phone or touch screen the bin always shows, because pointing never happens there.

steps.path: Project switcher → bin on a synced project
steps.headline: Removing a synced project now stops syncing it and takes it off your lists on all your devices.
steps.changed: New wording, a red "Remove from all devices" button, and a note that the GitHub backup stays, with Open on GitHub.
steps.notice: Every device keeps its copy of the files. YouCoded never deletes anything on GitHub. Syncing can't be turned back on for it.

steps.path: Settings → Backup & sync, after removing two projects
steps.headline: Backup & sync lists removed projects, each with Open on GitHub, and says how to delete the backup there yourself.
steps.changed: New "Removed projects" card, shown only when there is one. Same GitHub note as the confirm.
steps.notice: YouCoded only links to GitHub; deleting a backup is done on GitHub's own page.

steps.path: Project switcher at phone width, many projects
steps.headline: At phone width the old look fits: counts hide as before, pills stay, the bin shows on every row.
steps.changed: Same rows, narrower. "Not synced" is shorter than round 1's "Only on this computer", so names keep more room.
steps.notice: The bin always shows on touch screens.

steps.headline: In a small window the old switcher fits and scrolls its list.
steps.notice: Add a project stays at the bottom of the popup.

steps.path: Project switcher, the project you are in
steps.headline: Three new ways to mark the project you're already in. Which reads best?
steps.notice: Each picture has the pointer on the second row, so the marking isn't hidden under the highlight. My pick is the check: closest to the old one, now beside the name.

variants.label: Check by name
variants.summary: The old check, small and in the accent colour, right after the name.

variants.label: Edge bar
variants.summary: An accent bar down the row's left edge, like a sidebar's "you are here".

variants.label: Words
variants.summary: "Current project" in the accent colour before the folder path.
variants.risk: Pushes the path along; a long path is cut sooner.

steps.path: The project's own page, its sync pill
steps.headline: Should the project page's sync pill also say "Not synced" instead of "Only on this computer"?
steps.today: The switcher now says "Not synced" for a folder that doesn't sync; the project's own page still says "Only on this computer" for the same thing.
steps.problem: One project, two wordings, depending on where you look.
steps.proposal: Change the project page to "Not synced" too, or keep its longer words where there is room.

options.label: Match: Not synced
cons: Loses the hint that the files are only on this computer

options.label: Keep both
pros: The page, with more room, says more
